resources.string: On the computer, open Settings → Phone and turn Phone points on. Then scan the QR code it shows.
Can\'t reach the computer. Check that this phone\'s hotspot is on, the computer is connected to it, and Phone points is on.
That isn\'t a Seki Quest code. Scan the QR code under Settings → Phone on the computer.
The scanner couldn\'t start. You can also scan the code with the camera app, open the link, and share it to Seki Quest.
